ModMetaData.name: Mandrake Flame Statues
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Sculptures that burn (FLAME_STATUES_MOD_BUILD_1, design/RimMandrake/statue_mods_spec.md, Mod 2).
The sculptor's table can carve three flame statues in stone or metal: the ember idol (small), the flame dancer (person-sized) and the pyre colossus (2x2). Fed with chemfuel, each carries a flame and lights the room; left dry it is an ordinary sculpture.
Not here yet (filed): flames on every vent (palms, shoulders) with quality scaling and Mod Settings, the carved art itself (a shared placeholder sprite stands in), and the Helixien gas pipe link.
